classification.difficultyReason: Choose a shared tick interval and represent the addends as consecutive rightward jumps, interpreting endpoints that pass one whole.

content.prompt: Use a number line to illustrate what is meant by:

answer.worked:
Start at $0$, jump $\frac34$ to the right, then jump $\frac12$ to the right to reach $1\frac14$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac34+\frac12&=\frac34+\frac24\\\frac34+\frac12&=\frac54\\\frac34+\frac12&=1\frac14\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Quarter ticks with successive rightward jumps from zero to three quarters and then five quarters.

$$\begin{align*}\frac45+\frac1{10}&=\frac8{10}+\frac1{10}\\\frac45+\frac1{10}&=\frac9{10}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Tenths marked from zero to fourteen tenths, with jumps to eight tenths and nine tenths.

answer.worked:
Start at $0$, jump $\frac78$ to the right, then jump $\frac34$ to the right to reach $1\frac58$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac78+\frac34&=\frac78+\frac68\\\frac78+\frac34&=\frac{13}{8}\\\frac78+\frac34&=1\frac58\end{align*}$$
